item.title: China’s economy gains pace on exports as domestic demand falters
item.description: In the July-September quarter, China recorded an economic growth of 4.5%, surpassing analysts' expectations. While exports showed strong performance, internal demand is tempering due to a sluggish property sector. The International Monetary Fund has projected a 4.5% growth rate for 2026, and Beijing aims for a 4.5%-5% growth this year. Meanwhile, trade imbalance concerns ignite dialogue among trading partners seeking sustainable solutions. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
